about_the_game:
Venture into the opening chapter of The Adventurer’s Trial — a procedurally generated pixel-art sandbox filled with opportunities…and lurking dangers. In this free demo, you can explore, build, farm, and face your very first epic challenge.

Demo Features

  • Boundless exploration (limited biome) – Journey across the vast grassy plains, the only biome available in this demo. The full game will feature many more diverse biomes yet to be revealed.

  • Boss encounter (demo-exclusive) – Hunt down and defeat the demo’s single powerful boss. The full game will introduce multiple unique bosses with their own mechanics, loot, and secrets.

  • Diverse combat styles – Wield swords, bows, or wands—each with distinct skills. When you fall, a personal loot chest is left behind just for you to reclaim.

  • Base building & light farming – Place walls, floors, and doors to shape your camp. Gather resources, plant crops, and start your journey of self-sufficiency.

  • Crafting progression (simplified) – In this demo, you can craft with wool and leather to create your first gear. The full game expands progression with mining, metals (copper, iron, mithril, adamantite), and extensive recipe unlocks.

  • Life & Combat skills – Earn EXP from fighting and gathering, and unlock combat or life skills to enhance your adventure.

Multiplayer

  • The demo is single-player only.

  • The full game will let you host your own world and play cooperatively with up to 3 friends (no PvP).

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 430
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Every adventurer must face the Trial — a boundless pixel-art sandbox where you can explore, build, mine, farm, and challenge epic bosses. The demo is single-player only, but the full game will let you play with up to 3 friends in thrilling top-down adventures.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
